description:
[Calculators] What recycling a list of items yields. Expected outputs (quantity x per-unit yield x chance) per input and in total, for the chosen recycler type
(the standard monument recycler unless you say otherwise).

items.description: Comma-separated `shortname:quantity` pairs (display names work too; quantity defaults to 1).

recycler.description: `recycler` (standard monument recycler, 50%), `safe_zone` (Outpost/Bandit Camp/floating cities, 40%), `powered` (monument recycler with the Power Plant grid at stage 2+, 60%) or `red` (the Power Plant's red recycler, 75%, needs grid stage 4).

name: calculate_recycle_yield
title: What recycling a list of items yields
